scope: Same-visible-pixel, optional woodland submission test only. Original art, shader, support radius, foliage mask, shade, time, flight and level of detail unchanged. No newly identified trees, imagery or height data; not a default-mode or photorealism release.
projection: Use original Three.js 53-degree vertical FOV, 0.08m near, 350000m far, identical camera matrices and fixed simulation/world time. For templates below, eye=center+dist*(east,south)/length, eyeY=fixedEyeY or terrain.elevation(eye)+agl, aimY=fixedBaseH or terrain.elevation(center), PLUS h/2. Keep DPR1. Drop roll (except registered roll probes).

primary.ratioGate: at least one whole demonstrably offscreen nonzero-fade source crown rejected at every county; each primary forward view has fewer submitted near-volume triangles; pooled three forward near-volume triangles >=25% lower than their corresponding full round rosters. No change to projected individual branches; full-scene draws must not increase.

profiles.crownBark: ?woodlandCrownBase&woodlandBark, wait for gain==1 and registered crown, no async changes within pairs; test three genuine authored grazing cams
profiles.wholeWoodland: ?woodlandView: complete source mask/ground shadow/optional forestFloor/camera preserved (no new settings or release URL).
control: No flags, Standard never constructs near volume
No MSAA woodland, no extra option query or volume draws
Queens high 152m horizontal d62 with original aim 8; actual selected=0
No valid camera/nonfinite/orthographic or unhandled multiview if unsupported: full legacy submission, never a blank forest

motion.origin: Queens-close unchanged eye; update true same-frame camera matrices ahead of visibility selection, not next tick. Compare actual current-tick full tree submission at EVERY step.
motion.nearStraddle: deterministically lowest circular slot with nonzero side extent: move camera to within 0.08m of original trunk (known original shape) aiming along and away, plus orthogonal directions, not required to cull anything
motion.cameraState: cross camera yaw without translation, resize portrait→landscape, active flight->Pause->camera->resume, revisit same source from opposite heading. No paused stale camera culling, wrong-eye shadows, hysteresis gaps, new allocations/recaches when census unchanged.

urbanGate: all three real releases / actual Standard have no near volume, no new fetch, algorithm no-op (even over a real wooded positive without flag). In explicit preview, preserve exactly old tree membership and all urban roofs, harbor, pavement, hedges, shade/model; if city happens to have old eligible trees do not remove them as a town rule. Real place controls without optional volume alone cannot prove active culling.
safety: For each omitted original slot prove all vertices/candidate convex envelopes are strictly beyond a common original homogeneous clip plane (allow additional margin for source transforms, crownLift .76 warp/MSAA/float); no centre-only halfspace/circle; projected overlap kept, including crowns rooted behind eye or outside top/side. Every full roster and tree order, root, variant, H/W/color/seed/spin/lift and mask (typed-array hashes), 2D and grounded shadow membership must remain identical. Retained original order within each variant; every draw surviving stream and geometry/shader uniform unchanged. Unknown/missing/invalid transform/projection always full, no optimistic previous-camera cache. Culling may only change volume submit counts, not simulation or material.
optical: Strict 0 different RGBA8 pixels over whole frame for full→cull→full same-tick at every primary/opposed/grazing/sample. Both full reads identical, same pass target size, clear color, MSAA state and camera; at least one genuinely visible branched tree (full vs no branched differs >100 pixels>2 at each primary county) and one alpha side intersection near opposite turns. Archive proof hashes, not merely screenshots. Add the same test with foreground/sky removed in QA to avoid huge envelopes hiding mistakes; report tested occlusion control separately. Log actual gl.drawElementsInstanced counts, not trusted culler counters, and frame source projection once per render. Exact pixel equality, not approximate IoU or noise tolerance.
cost: No new pass/draw/sampler/network/material/object per tree. Retain <=old positive draws; if batching costs additional draws, reject. On unchanged camera+roster zero new instance data uploads across 30 stable ticks (compare actual bufferSubData), and yield under changing camera ordered source membership. Counters: full/selected/nonzero shader fade sum vs actually drawn counts and source triangles. For claimed speed rather than workload, use warm-cache ABBA 4x32 timed ordinary frames, warmup >=24, no PNG readback/timers in timed loop; collect per-direction position/heading churn, clip CPU separately from WebGL wall, p50/p95, noise from A/A, no p95 regression >max(5%,0.5ms) under the same setup. A software renderer does not imply device FPS; no speedup claim from triangles alone.
status: Registered before any candidate or new framebuffer measurement. Numeric gates cannot be silently relaxed; potential grant may remain an optional geometry submission reduction without increasing visual fidelity.
